edits.value_json: 上 is an indicative graph: a short mark above a reference line indicates the upper side. Early forms are described with either a curved or horizontal line. The account in 字源 also describes this construction and reports that Spring-and-Autumn forms added a vertical stroke.

The mark’s position above a reference line indicates the upper side. The received Shuowen text also classifies 上 as indicative; this records a Han-era analysis, not independent confirmation of the graph’s earlier history.
